title: ChronoPatch: Black-Box Energy-Latency Attacks on Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as generative inference services, where autoregressive decoding makes response length a key determinant of latency and computational cost. This creates an availability risk: adversarial visual inputs can prolong generation and increase serving overhead. Existing energy-latency attacks typically rely on gradients, logits, or token-level feedback, leaving open whether such risks persist when an attacker observes only the final response. We present ChronoPatch, a black-box attack that induces prolonged VLM generation requiring only the final response. It discovers visual delay anchors through response-length-guided evolutionary search, then minimizes perturbation magnitude through subspace-calibrated decision-based optimization. Across four open-source VLMs, ChronoPatch increases inference latency by 47.86%--293.34% and GPU energy consumption by 41.44%--249.70% under a 5% spatial bud

translated_title: ChronoPatch：针对视觉语言模型的黑盒能耗-延迟攻击
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型越来越多地被部署为生成式推理服务，其中自回归解码使得响应长度成为延迟和计算成本的关键决定因素。这带来了可用性风险：对抗性视觉输入可以延长生成过程并增加服务开销。现有的能耗-延迟攻击通常依赖于梯度、logits或token级别的反馈，因而攻击者仅能观察最终响应时这种风险是否仍然存在尚不明确。我们提出了ChronoPatch，一种仅需最终响应即可诱导VLM延长生成的黑盒攻击。该方法通过响应长度引导的进化搜索发现视觉延迟锚点，随后通过子空间校准的基于决策的优化来最小化扰动幅度。在四个开源视觉语言模型上，ChronoPatch在5%的空间预算下将推理延迟增加了47.86%–293.34%，将GPU能耗增加了41.44%–249.70%。
tldr: ChronoPatch提出了一种仅需观察最终响应的黑盒攻击方法，通过响应长度引导的进化搜索和子空间校准的决策式优化，使视觉语言模型的推理延迟和GPU能耗显著增加。
en_tdlr: ChronoPatch introduces a black-box attack that requires only the final response, using response-length-guided evolutionary search and subspace-calibrated decision-based optimization to significantly increase VLM inference latency and GPU energy consumption.
